Subject: Post-demo: procurement gatekeeper checklist + invoice expectations

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap and three asks so we can lock the pilot start date: 

1) Procurement path: you mentioned an internal "gatekeeper" team that validates vendor paperwork before procurement issues a PO. Can you confirm whether BrightGrid requires a supplier setup form + W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU)? Which group will own supplier onboarding?

2) Commercial path: we heard three options on the call — marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace), campus PO via AP with net terms, or card for pilot. Which option does BrightGrid prefer for an initial pilot (single team, limited spend)? If marketplace is preferred, will the finance team still need an invoice back to BrightGrid, or do they prefer marketplace billing only?

3) Invoice format & timing: to avoid back-and-forth with AP, can you confirm: invoicing currency (USD), billing address, BrightGrid tax ID/EIN, required invoice fields (PO number, remittance email), and whether you require e-invoicing (Peppol) or a PDF attachment by email?

Attached: redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (example layout we can generate), procurement-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (what we typically complete for customers), and a draft SOW that outlines pilot deliverables.

Next steps: if you can reply inline with the three items above, we’ll update the paperwork and aim to schedule the procurement handoff call next week.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Irene — appreciate the clear recap. Answers inline: 

1) Supplier setup: our Vendor Ops team (procurement@brightgrid.com) owns onboarding. For US vendors we need an EIN + W-9. For vendors billing from outside the US we need VAT registration and a certificate of fiscal representation if applicable. I’ll loop in Vendor Ops separately with a supplier setup form.

2) Commercial path: for pilots under $20k we usually accept card or PO (card preferred for speed). For anything we expect to scale beyond the pilot we shift to PO + Net45. We are evaluating AWS Marketplace for cataloguing solutions, but finance has been cautious about marketplace contracts because they sometimes complicate cost-center chargebacks.

3) Invoice format & timing: USD is fine. Billing address below. We do require the PO number on the top-right and a separate field for remit-to email (ap@brightgrid.com). We prefer a PDF invoice emailed to ap@brightgrid.com; e-invoicing is not mandatory for pilots but we may request Peppol onboarding later.

Billing address: BrightGrid Inc
Accounts Payable
1234 Harbor Drive
Suite 200
San Mateo, CA 94401
EIN: 12-3456789
Remit email: ap@brightgrid.com

I’ll ask Vendor Ops to send you the supplier setup form and expected SLA for vendor validation (usually 3–5 business days once paperwork is complete).

Regards,
Elaine
Director, Technical Procurement
BrightGrid Inc
